title.narrative: Strengthening Ecuador's sustainable finance governance mechanism

description.narrative: In 2024, Ecuador implemented a sustainable finance roundtable with the support of GGGI. This mechanism aims to coordinate the efforts of the public and private sectors, academia, and civil society to accelerate the mobilization of sustainable finance. The purpose of this project is to strengthen the capacities of the stakeholders involved in this mechanism, enable their working groups, and facilitate the process of developing a national green taxonomy.

Strengthened National Enabling Environment for Sustainable Finance, supported by a strategic Green Taxonomy Roadmap and inclusive governance mechanisms, that advances equitable, Low-Carbon, and Climate-resilient economic transformation.
